money_kinds.external: Cash that comes from outside the loop: lenders, outside investors, end customers. It is still not free money: lenders and investors must be repaid or earn a return from future end-user spending.
money_kinds.recycled: Cash that started with a loop participant and returns to that participant or its customers, for example Nvidia equity in a customer that buys Nvidia systems.
money_kinds.promise: Contracts, backlog, RPO, backstops, guarantees, warrants, leases, letters of intent, and equity purchases that only close on a condition (for example an IPO closing). NOT cash moved. Never added into cash totals.
money_kinds.mixed: An aggregate round that contains both vendor money (recycled) and outside money (external). See money_split for the parts. Excluded from sums because the component edges are charted separately.
money_kinds.outside_loop_investment: Nvidia's own cash invested in a company that is not a customer in the AI-demand loop (for example Intel, Synopsys, Nokia). It is neither outside money entering the loop nor recycled customer money. Excluded from loop totals; shown on the Nvidia node as a separate line.
